wins.label: Strong earnings growth
wins.evidence: Our net income increased to $21.3 billion and our diluted earnings per share grew 17% from a year ago

wins.label: Asset cap removal
wins.evidence: The removal of the asset cap by the Federal Reserve was a pivotal moment for the company

wins.label: ROTCE improvement
wins.evidence: Our ROTCE increased to 15% in 2025...we have a new medium-term ROTCE target of 17% to 18%

wins.label: Strong loan growth
wins.evidence: Period-end loans grew 5% in the third quarter, the strongest linked quarter growth since the first quarter of 2020

wins.label: Credit card momentum
wins.evidence: We opened nearly 3 million new credit card accounts in 2025, up 21% from a year ago

risks.label: Lower share repurchases
risks.evidence: Given we have many opportunities to grow organically, we currently expect share repurchases to be lower in 2026

risks.label: Credit card rate cap uncertainty
risks.evidence: it's too early to know because we're not quite sure what the ultimate actions of whether it's the administration or of Congress choose to go down

risks.label: Office portfolio losses
risks.evidence: Commercial net loan charge-offs increased 4 basis points from the third quarter driven by higher commercial real estate losses predominantly in the office portfolio

risks.label: Rate headwinds to NII
risks.evidence: You got rates coming down which will be a headwind for NII ex-markets

risks.label: Lower margin trading assets
risks.evidence: While many of the assets have been added recently are lower margin, they also have lower risk and are less capital intensive
